'''Ryssa Jadeonar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] known for being the scourge of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She and her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Kallaaddik]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3643 BBY]], where both were defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Ryssa Jadeonar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hostile NPC on the Republic version of Taris.
